    m.addConstr(3.64 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.41 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.95 * vars['Var_5'] <= 78.37, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(0.29 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.82 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.26 * vars['Var_2'] + 8.37 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.7 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.51 * vars['Var_5'] <= 96.5, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(9.26 * vars['Var_0'] + 7.4 * vars['Var_1'] + 3.77 * vars['Var_2'] + 2.9 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.48 * vars['Var_4'] + 5.69 * vars['Var_5'] <= 158.19, name='C6')
